title: Officers
description: Optional undercrew choice. Named NPCs specialising in certain skills, languages, or aspects.

options.name: Skillful Officer
options.description: A seasoned wildsailor, likely on the verge of leaving the undercrew for a main crew position.
options.special: Has 2 ranks in any skill and 1 rank in any other skill.

options.name: Well-Travelled Officer
options.description: An eager contributor to discussions and a font of lore, wise in the ways of the wider waves.
options.special: Has 2 ranks in any language and 1 rank in any other language.

options.name: Experienced Officer
options.description: A seasoned wildsailor with access to a full aspect.
options.special: Has any one aspect. The officer's track equals the track of that aspect.
